name: Torrid-Architrave
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed glass plains from an ancient cataclysm in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Regular pulses leave the monolithic structures of unknown origin aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
